title: tvOS kit: sign-in
summary: The tvOS kit's sign-in in both presets on a 1920 x 1080 stage inside the title-safe area, drawn as a labelled fixture of Diceroll: the code view with its QR, URL, code and countdown, the device limit with its QR to the phone, and Code expired, plus the one line the integrator writes.
compare: The only surface in this set that draws a QR (DL14: TV, console and pad-only screens): 435px (under 42% of the 1080 short side), whole 15px modules, a 92% white tile with a quiet zone of two modules, beside the URL and the code in text; the QR, the URL and the code carry the same sign-in.

DL1 on a TV: two panes, the start pane holds the product header, title, instruction, the URL on its own line, the code and the countdown; the end pane holds the QR, the device line and the controls; top-aligned inside the 90 x 60 title-safe insets. The expired state is a message screen: one block with trailing actions, no split.

DL9: the focus engine replaces the kit's ring. polaris-key draws the lifted (1.05) primary in the accent with a 3px ring at a 2px offset; native draws the system's lifted white control. First focus is Use a license key instead (never an opener), and Try again after a refusal.
DL6: the device limit is a neutral callout, no danger colour or error glyph; the fix is on the phone, so the one primary is Try again and Cancel stays.
polaris-key tints the stage with Diceroll's art, blurred and faded (the ambient); native has a flat system ground. The accent is Diceroll's (kits are not service-accented).
Type is at the TV floor (29px and up; 76px titles), controls are 90px capsules, weights 400/500/600, no glow.
The device line is 'This TV' (part.thisDeviceTitle, tv). The manage URL on the device-limit frame stands in for the integrator's manageUrl.
The stage is drawn at its true size and scaled to the cell, so text measures are the TV's, not the board's.
Phone: the 1920 x 1080 frames are hidden below tablet width, as the landscape phones are on the other kit boards, because a TV scaled to 390px has no legible type or targets.

designReview.reviewer: UX designer (visual critique of rendered screenshots, mockup mode)
designReview.verdict: Good after one fix round: no QR on a desktop surface, every refusal neutral, one primary per frame; the clipped visionOS panel, copy drift between boards and screens, mixed accents on the polaris-key cards and weak polaris focus rings were fixed.

findings.issue: Copy for the same step differed between the boards and these screens (sign-in wording, Back and Cancel on inline steps, offline action, expired code).
findings.resolution: One wording everywhere: the sign-in step reads 'Check the code there matches this one.' with 'Or go to <url>'; inline steps say Back, only sheets say Cancel; the offline action is Try again; the expired code uses the catalog sentence.

findings.issue: The visionOS panel clipped Cancel on sign-in and device limit.
Vertical centring of the TV and desktop columns.
findings.resolution: declined: DL1 top-aligns the panes with the panel's content.
